_comment: Expansion 3 part E.1: spells outside battle - healing, return from death, food and the body, shelter and watch (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook, checked on the page images. What they do outside a fight: game/revival.py (return from death), game/spellwork.py (the rest).

aid.name: Aid
aid.text: Up to three friends within 30 feet: their hit point maximum and hit points rise by 5 for 8 hours (5 more for each slot level above 2).

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.text: A ward round the camp for 8 hours: anything that comes near wakes you, and nobody gets at the animals unseen.

create_food_and_water.name: Create Food and Water
create_food_and_water.text: Forty-five pounds of bland food (fifteen days of eating, spoiling in a day) and thirty gallons of clean water.

create_or_destroy_water.name: Create or Destroy Water
create_or_destroy_water.text: Ten gallons of clean water (ten more for each slot level above 1): the thirsty drink, the skins are filled.

gentle_repose.name: Gentle Repose
gentle_repose.text: A fallen friend's body is kept from decay for 10 days, and those days do not count against Raise Dead.

goodberry.name: Goodberry
goodberry.text: Ten berries: each feeds a body for a day and heals 1 hit point. They are gone in a day.

heroes_feast.name: Heroes' Feast

material.text: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

heroes_feast.text: A feast for twelve, eaten in an hour: for a day, +2d10 hit points and maximum, resistance to poison, no poison or fear.

leomunds_tiny_hut.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
leomunds_tiny_hut.text: A dome round the camp for 8 hours: nothing gets in, and inside it is dry and comfortable whatever the weather.

mordenkainens_faithful_hound.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
mordenkainens_faithful_hound.text: A phantom watchdog for 8 hours: it barks at whatever comes and bites the first (4d8 force, Dexterity save).

mordenkainens_magnificent_mansion.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
mordenkainens_magnificent_mansion.text: A door out of the world for a day: a banquet, warm beds, and rest though enemies hunt outside.

purify_food_and_drink.name: Purify Food and Drink
purify_food_and_drink.text: The rot and poison go out of the food and water you carry: turned food is fresh, foul water clean.

raise_dead.name: Raise Dead

material.text: a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

raise_dead.text: Calls back someone dead up to 10 days, with 1 hit point, mortal wounds closed: -4 to d20 rolls, one less a long rest.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.text: For an hour the flesh knits: every hit point and every wound mended, and what was cut off grows back.

reincarnate.name: Reincarnate

material.text: rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

reincarnate.text: Someone dead up to 10 days wakes in a new body, of a people the dice choose, whole and unhurt.

remove_curse.name: Remove Curse
remove_curse.text: A cursed thing's grip on someone breaks: the bond ends, and it can be taken off and thrown away.

resurrection.name: Resurrection

material.text: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

resurrection.text: Calls back someone dead up to a century, whole and with every hit point: -4 to d20 rolls, one less a long rest.

rope_trick.name: Rope Trick
rope_trick.text: A rope climbs to a space out of the world for an hour: a short rest there, though enemies hunt nearby.

true_resurrection.name: True Resurrection

material.text: diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

true_resurrection.text: Calls back someone dead up to 200 years: whole, every hit point, poison, sickness and curses gone.
